Executive summary of study results: O see Attached lJNJA
A cell based system has been developed to examine LPA receptor activation by various LPA isoforms and also to
evaluate the inhibition of signaling by anti-LPA antibodies. Using these assays we have demonstrated that B3 and
LT 3114 anti-LPA antibodies were potent in blocking the binding of different LPA isoforms to LPA receptor 1 and
preventing its activation.
